name: Aral Sea (South / Large Aral)
cadence_note: every 3th year (plus 2025) to fit the time budget; not interpolated
why_selected: Classic irrigation-driven collapse (Amu Darya / Syr Darya diversion). Data-only description; shared by Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan.
mndwi_note: Very large lake: 240 m resolution and every 3rd year. Southern/eastern basins dried up; the 1985-90 extent defines the analysis polygon, so later shrinkage is measured inside it. Boundary with the North Aral at 46.1 N is approximate.

lake_polygon.method: largest connected MNDWI>0 component (pixel water in >=50% of valid years) containing the seed, +1 km buffer

basin.fallback_reason: ValueError: no basin intersects the lake polygon

masks_encoding: PNG uint8: 0 no data, 90 land, 255 water; grid.json has crs/affine/shape
